nodes.label: Stack Quirk: WS Broadcast via OpenConnections.listAll()
nodes.rationale: findByEndpointId() is not in the public 3.20 API; OpenConnections.listAll() is the correct broadcast pattern.

nodes.label: Stack Quirk: Postgres NULL Named Parameter Type Inference
nodes.rationale: Named parameter with NULL value fails Postgres type inference — branch SQL instead (see MechanicRepository.findNearest).

nodes.label: Stack Quirk: Custom DispatchGantt (not react-big-calendar)
nodes.rationale: RBC resource view puts resources as columns, not rows. Dispatch board needs mechanic rows × time columns (Gantt style), so a custom DispatchGantt was built. RBC is still used by AbsenceCalendarPicker.

nodes.label: Stack Quirk: @dnd-kit/core Drag Kinds (pool/event/resize)
nodes.rationale: Three drag kinds discriminated via DragStartEvent.active.data.current.kind: pool (unassigned card → POST schedule), event (existing block reassign/reschedule → PATCH schedule), resize (right-edge handle → PATCH schedule with updated scheduledEndAt). rowRefs Map used to convert cursor position to wall-clock time.
